dialogue.text: Ni byo, ariko kubera iki social media zikwiyongera gutegura kuri ubwoko bw’amahoro yacu?
dialogue.translation: That's true, but why is social media increasingly influencing our peace?

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ni byo, kandi ntihabaye ubwoko bw’amahoro mu bantu.

dialogue.text: Ego, ariko kwemeza ubushakashatsi ni cyo cyabanza, tugomba kwiyongera gutegura.

dialogue.translation: Although it is a type of image, it can be used to explain things.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: N’ukuri, ari ico gituma twebwe dusaba gutanga ibintu mu ishusho.
dialogue.translation: Indeed, that’s why we ask to give things in images.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ahantu, kwemeza ko ibyo twarabonanye birashoboka kwiyongera gukoreshwa.
dialogue.translation: However, we need to confirm that what we discussed can continue to be used.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kubera ico, twebwe dusaba gutanga amakuru menshi mu gutegura.
dialogue.translation: Because of that, we ask to give more details in the explanation.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kuri kandi, ibyo dusaba ni ukwo kwemeza ko byose byari byo kuri ishusho.
dialogue.translation: And moreover, what we are asking is to confirm that everything was on the image.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Niba dusaba neza, AI yongeye gutumika mu buri ahantu, ariko ubwoko bwo kugenzura byagombye kwemeza.
dialogue.translation: If we ask properly, AI can continue to be used in every place, but the type of regulation needs to be confirmed.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: N’ukuri, kubera ko AI igomba gutanga ubushakashatsi bwo kwirinda ubwoba.
dialogue.translation: Indeed, because AI needs to provide security to prevent fear.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ariko, ese ubwoko bw’ishusho AI iranguraho gutegura ni ikimenyetso?
dialogue.translation: But, isn’t the type of image AI creates a sign of choosing?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ego, kuri buri kigeraniro, dusobanukirwa ko AI irimo ubwenge bw’umuntu.
dialogue.translation: Yes, in every discussion, we are reminded that AI has human intelligence.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nuko rero, dusaba neza ko AI yongere gutumika mu njera y’ubutabera.
dialogue.translation: So, we ask that AI continues to be used in a way that is ethical.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Iyo ni ukuri, ariko twebwe abanyarwanda turakeneye kwemeza ko AI itegura neza.
dialogue.translation: That’s true, but we Rwandans need to confirm that AI chooses well.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ubukere mu Rwanda byagiye gukura neza kubera amahanga y’isi yose yashyize kwishyura uburyo abantu bakora.
dialogue.translation: The situation in Rwanda has changed well because all countries in the world have started to influence the way people work.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ni byo, ariko ntekereza ko ubutunzi bw’abantu bose buri mu bwoko, byagiye kwiyongera gutegura amajyambere y’ubwoko bw’abantu.
dialogue.translation: That's true, but I think that the wealth of all people, regardless of type, has continued to challenge the progress of people's types.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Iyo ntekereza ko kwemeza uburyo abantu bakoresha ubutunzi bwabo buri kuri munsi, byagiye gutumika neza.
dialogue.translation: If I think that confirming the way people use their wealth every day has been utilized well.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Byoba byo, ariko ntekereza ko kugirango dusubire kwishyura uburyo abantu bakora, dusaba gukura ubwoko bw’amahoro mu buzima.
dialogue.translation: It would be so, but I think that in order for us to continue influencing the way people work, we need to change the type of peace in life.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ni byo, kandi ntekereza ko gutegura uburyo abantu bakoresha ubutunzi bwabo, byagiye kwiyongera gutumika neza.
dialogue.translation: That's true, and I think that challenging the way people use their wealth has continued to be utilized well.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Rero, dusaba kwemeza ko gukura ubwoko bw’amahoro mu buzima, byagiye kwishyura uburyo abantu bakora.
dialogue.translation: Therefore, we need to confirm that changing the type of peace in life has influenced the way people work.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ni ico kibazo, kandi ntekereza ko gutumika neza ubutunzi bw’abantu bose, byagiye kwiyongera gukura uburyo abantu bakora.
dialogue.translation: That's the issue, and I think that utilizing the wealth of all people well has continued to change the way people work.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Byoba byo, rero dusaba kwemeza ko kwishyura uburyo abantu bakora, byagiye gutegura ubwoko bw’amahoro mu buzima.
dialogue.translation: It would be so, therefore we need to confirm that influencing the way people work has challenged the type of peace in life.
